about: Rules for B1's closure test (scripts/build-bundle.mjs --stage closure; docs/DEVELOPING.md, 'The data sets'). Each class, and each .sty in a package's own tex/latex folder, loads alone in a minimal document. 'setup' gives a file the preamble it needs first, when it works only on top of another package. 'expected' lists failures that are right, each with its reason. For core-data: helpers and documentation tools that need a package only extra-data holds, font options whose fonts are in extra-data, old code a package loads only on an older LaTeX, and LuaTeX branches. For extra-data: files that need a package the data sets leave out (a larger font package, PSTricks, Chinese fonts; engine/bundle-sets.json gives why), files not meant to load alone (documentation classes, files that ask on the terminal, a theme or helper that needs its class, a class that needs an option), and files that load a file TeX Live no longer has. 'expectedPatterns' lists kinds of file by a regular expression on the path, each with its reason. The report says which missing files extra-data holds, names a file listed by name that loads now, and, after a whole run, a pattern that took no failure. Any other failure stops the build.
